text: 南非储备银行（央行）、审慎监管局（Prudential Authority）和金融部门行为监管局（FSCA）正在编制一份关于人工智能（AI）的联合讨论文件，其中将纳入对智能体AI（agentic AI）的专项考量，为未来制定该行业的监管框架做准备。
text_en: The South African Reserve Bank (SARB), the Prudential Authority, and the Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) are preparing a joint discussion paper on artificial intelligence (AI), which will include special consideration for agentic AI, as part of preparations for future regulatory frameworks in the sector.
